assumptions: Battery: 100 MW, round-trip efficiency 0.85, degradation 10 $/MWh discharged, empty at every midnight. Results in $/kW-yr; partial years are annualized as 365 / days covered.

Price taker: the battery never moves prices. AS markets are thin, and as more batteries offer AS the clearing prices fall (saturation), so AS revenue is an upper bound on what a new battery could capture.
AS revenue = award x clearing price (MCPC). No deployment energy except Regulation; no mileage, penalties, qualification or outages.

Regulation deployment factor 0.1 (ASSUMPTION): Average energy deployed per MW of Regulation award, as a share of the award, for each of Reg Up (discharge) and Reg Down (charge). No ERCOT source with a typical value was found. 10% is used so that regulation awards move state of charge and earn or pay the energy price. Set to 0 to ignore deployment.
Headroom: discharge + up-products <= P, charge + Reg Down <= P, charge + discharge <= P. State of charge must back each award for its duration at both ends of every interval.

Reserve durations (h) for Reg Up, Reg Down, RRS, ECRS, Non-Spin before RTC+B: 1, 1, 1, 2, 4; from RTC+B: 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1, 4. Pre-RTC+B Regulation and RRS use a conservative one hour (ASSUMPTION). Sources in model/config/as_rules.json.
ECRS earns nothing before its first DAM price (June 10, 2023).

foresight: Energy at RT 15-minute settlement point prices with perfect foresight. AS at the DAM clearing price (MCPC, NP4-188-CD) held for the whole hour before RTC+B. From RTC+B, AS per 15 minutes at the higher of the DAM MCPC for that hour and the settled RT MCPC (NP6-796-ER). This is an upper bound.

realistic: Energy schedule and AS awards chosen from DAM prices only (DA settlement point prices and DAM MCPC), hourly. The energy schedule is settled at RT 15-minute prices, as in model/forecast.py. AS awards are paid the DAM MCPC and held in real time.
sources: RT AS clearing prices from RTC+B: https://www.ercot.com/mp/data-products/data-product-details?id=NP6-796-ER
Hub energy prices: ERCOT annual archives NP6-785-ER (RT) and NP4-180-ER (DA)
Node energy prices: ERCOT public API NP6-905-CD (RT 15-min) and NP4-190-CD (DA hourly)
